blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Though he is happy to appear before the Department of Justice (DOJ) for an obstruction of justice complaint, Sen. Robin Padilla said on Wednesday that he would rather face the International Criminal Court (ICC). Padilla remarked after the Philippine National Police filed an obstruction of justice charge against him for supposedly helping Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa evade an ICC arrest warrant. “Ang kaso ko ay nagmula sa warrant of arrest ng ICC na isang dayuhan. Parang pakiramdam ko discriminated ako… Sana dalhin niyo na lang sa ICC ang kaso tutal sila ang sinasabi na dun ako nagkaroon […]... Keep on reading: Padilla on obstruction rap: Bring my case to ICC
